evidence.says: LC identifies Richard H. Rouse, fuller name Richard Hunter, born 1933, died 2022. Its source notes cite Catalogus de libris autenticis et apocrifis (1963) under Richard Hunter Rouse and identify a UCLA professor with a Cornell Ph.D. in 1963. These match the graph dissertation title, year and department. LC links Q106576763 as an identified entity and Q55937949 as a close external authority.

Q55937949 is Richard H. Rouse, also Richard Hunter Rouse; birth year 1933, death year 2022, UCLA affiliation and Cornell doctorate in 1963. Its LC identifier is n86070596; VIAF identifiers 102316635 and 27092326 and ISNI 0000000109294947 also occur in the LC record.
Requesting entity data for LC-linked Q106576763 returns entity Q55937949, showing that the other QID now resolves to the item being checked.

UCLA identifies Richard Rouse as a Distinguished Research Professor and medieval historian in its department since 1963, specializing in medieval books and manuscripts; its memorial states his death year as 2022.

notes: The lc_links_other_item flag reflects an alternate QID that now resolves to Q55937949, rather than a different person. Retain Q55937949; no replacement QID is needed. LC and Wikidata agree on birth year 1933. LC and Wikidata were read through their public JSON representations because their HTML pages were unavailable through the browser tool.
